input.command: ps aux | rg -i 'ethan_channel|telethon|ethan_bigdata' | rg -v rg; lsof "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/ethan_bigdata.session" 2>/dev/null; ls -la /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/ethan_bigdata* 2>/dev/null

content.text: `watch` 占着 session，先短暂停掉再扫，扫完立刻拉回。

input.command:
# How was watch started? LaunchAgent / nohup?
launchctl list 2>/dev/null | rg -i ethan || true
ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents/*ethan* 2>/dev/null
rg -n 'ethan_channel_bigdata_jobs' /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot ~/.dc-platform/scripts 2>/dev/null | head -20
ps -p 18445 -o ppid=,command=; ps -p $(ps -p 18445 -o ppid= | tr -d ' ') -o command= 2>/dev/null
input.description: Find how watch daemon is managed

input.command:
set -e
PLIST="$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.youchu.ethan-jobs-watch.plist"
echo "=== unload watch ==="
launchctl unload "$PLIST" 2>&1 || true
sleep 2
# ensure process gone
if pgrep -f 'ethan_channel_bigdata_jobs.py watch' >/dev/null; then
  pkill -f 'ethan_channel_bigdata_jobs.py watch' || true
  sleep 1
fi
ps aux | rg 'ethan_channel_bigdata_jobs' | rg -v rg || echo 'watch stopped'

echo "=== scan ==="
cd /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot
python3 scripts/ethan_channel_bigdata_jobs.py scan --days 14 --limit-per-chat 200 2>&1
SCAN_RC=$?

echo "=== reload watch ==="
launchctl load "$PLIST" 2>&1
sleep 2
pgrep -fl 'ethan_channel_bigdata_jobs.py watch' || echo 'WARN: watch not up'
exit $SCAN_RC
